name: Product Experience Completion

initiation_authorization.evidence: Human explicitly approved Phase 10 Product Experience Completion and authorized formal documentation and implementation. Real deploy, production, providers, credentials, public callbacks, cutover and Flowlog shutdown remain unauthorized.

plan_approval.evidence: Human explicitly approved the complete Phase 10 plan covering quick-order, inline customer creation, manual-value orders, Order Operational Actions, manual payment, Organization PIX, hosted checkout UX, pickup/dispatch, reporting, import/export, administration, design system, brand identity and revisable UX.

expected_models.name: Order.pricing_mode
expected_models.purpose: Explicit canonical source of order money: itemized or manual.

expected_models.name: Order.manual_total
expected_models.purpose: Canonical BRL total for manual-value orders with optional zero OrderItems.

expected_models.name: Future Organization-scoped payment settings
expected_models.purpose: Persist only approved non-secret PIX instructions when implemented; never provider credentials.

expected_features: Quick order creation with atomic reuse-or-create Customer behavior.
Manual versus itemized pricing with no silent divergence.
Organization-scoped customer/product autocomplete and optional neutral CEP lookup with manual fallback.
Contextual next actions in Order Workspace delegating to canonical domain services.
Auditable manual/offline payment confirmation without provider impersonation.
Organization-scoped PIX instructions that do not imply payment receipt.
Hosted checkout create/copy/send/cancel UX over Payments with external effects still disabled.
Delivery/pickup contextual operations, tracking communication and secure pickup validation.
Operational timeline, global search, saved filters, import/export, reports, profile, users, settings and audit surfaces.
Responsive design system, brand identity and logo candidates with explicit human visual review.
deferred_features: real provider activation or sandbox effects
Phase 11 cutover and Flowlog operational shutdown
ERP, fiscal, inventory, accounting and marketing domains

states.rule: Phase 10 adds no shared lifecycle. Orders, Payments, Fulfillment and Messaging keep independent canonical states; the workspace only derives eligible actions.

snapshots: Confirmed Order customer/item snapshots remain governed by the existing Orders contract.
Manual total is canonical Order money and is immutable after confirmation through the existing draft-only mutation boundary.
Reports/search/export read canonical fields and never persist a second source of business truth.
PIX instructions are configuration, not payment evidence; secrets/provider credentials remain excluded.
idempotency: Quick-order idempotency is claimed before inline Customer creation so retries cannot duplicate the Customer or Order.
Manual payment and other mutable Order Workspace commands must use existing domain command receipts/version checks.
Imports require batch identity and row-level deterministic handling so retries do not duplicate records.
Read-only reports/search/export do not introduce mutable receipts.
money_rules: itemized mode derives subtotal/discount/surcharge/total only from OrderItems and existing calculations.
manual mode uses manual_total as the single canonical total; products are optional and no fake Venda item is created.
A manual/itemized mismatch is never auto-reconciled; the operator must explicitly select the source before transition.
Payments always copy the persisted confirmed Order.total and never accept browser-supplied money.
authorization: Organization derives from active Membership/session and is never accepted as an arbitrary request tenant id.
Autocomplete/search/import/export/report selectors apply Organization scope at every root and relation.
Customer inline creation uses Customers policies; Orders creation uses Orders policies.
Manual payment and checkout operations remain manager-tier Payments actions unless a later approved policy explicitly narrows them.
OPERATOR masking cannot be bypassed through search, reports or export.
Order Workspace never grants permissions beyond the owning domain policy.

required: quick-order atomicity, idempotency and exact-document reuse
manual-payment authorization/idempotency/audit and active-checkout conflict handling
PIX instructions do not mutate payment state
Order Workspace action eligibility and delegation

coverage.domain_expectation: Quick-order, money-source, Organization isolation, manual payment, privacy/export and contextual action paths require direct tests.

documentation: updated domain contracts for any changed canonical behavior
acceptance_criteria: A simple manual-value order can be created in one journey without pre-creating Customer or Product.
Inline Customer creation is atomic with Order creation and respects canonical duplicate rules.
Manual and itemized pricing always have one unambiguous source of truth.
Order Workspace exposes only authorized/lifecycle-valid next actions and never merges domain lifecycles.
Manual payment, PIX instructions and hosted checkout are distinguishable and auditable.
Customer/Product import/export and reports remain Organization-scoped and privacy-safe.
Profile, users, settings and audit administration respect policies.
Visual candidate receives explicit human visual review and may be reworked within approved UX scope.
Coverage remains at least 85% and all CI gates pass on the material candidate.
Independent Review and QA/Security GO precede final human approval.
Deploy, production, provider activation, credentials, public callbacks, cutover and Flowlog closure remain outside Phase 10.

handoff_format.base_sha_semantics: Exact origin/main SHA resolved before branch creation.

allowed_scope: Product-experience completion across approved Vidalys Flow domains without creating a shared lifecycle.

Quick order, explicit pricing source, contextual Order Workspace actions, manual/offline payment UX, non-secret PIX instructions, pickup/dispatch speed, search, import/export, reports and administration.
Responsive design system, brand identity, logo candidates and human visual-review/rework checkpoint.
Narrow governance updates necessary to represent the approved new Phase 10 while deferring cutover to future Phase 11.
forbidden_scope: Collapsing Orders, Payments, Fulfillment or Messaging into a shared lifecycle.
Silent money reconciliation or fake product creation for manual totals.
Direct provider calls from Orders, Dashboard or templates.
Real providers, credentials, sandbox, public callbacks, deploy, production, cutover or Flowlog shutdown.
ERP, fiscal, accounting, tax, inventory or marketing domains.
branch_hygiene_note: Only phase/10-product-experience-completion is authorized for Phase 10 work. phase/11-cutover and phase/10-product-experience-completion-backup/docs were accidentally precreated at the unchanged Phase 09 closeout SHA and contain no Phase 10 work; they must not be used as candidate/dependency/baseline. Future Phase 11 must resolve a fresh origin/main after Phase 10 approval.
